_doc: Hollowed of the Larch Hollow outskirts. The Ashen Hollow is a Hollow in body (same stats and archetype as 'hollow'); it differs only in the look: the bodies characters/ashen_a, ashen_b are generated by tools/assetgen/blender/generators/character_ashen.py (character_body with the Ashen's lichen-ash skin, hide and homespun). Sleepers only: the AI director never spawns it.

defs.name: Ashen Hollow
defs.description: An Ashen watcher the Bloom took anyway: the lichen-ash still caked into the skin, a hide coat and bone beads. It came for you because you smelled of the road.
